Ocean Thirty-Nine

Dive watch, GMT · 39mm · 100m–300m · automatic

The Ocean Thirty-Nine is a family of Swiss-made dive and GMT watches known for its 39mm case diameter, offering a more classic and versatile size than the brand's larger 42mm models. The line is defined by designs that pay homage to iconic vintage and modern sport watches, combined with high-specification components like ceramic bezels and sapphire crystals.

The story

Introduced around 2018 as a smaller alternative to the established 42mm Ocean One collection, the Ocean Thirty-Nine quickly gained popularity among enthusiasts who preferred more traditional case dimensions. The family expanded from classic dive watch designs to include numerous variations with different bezel colors, dial layouts, and GMT complications, often inspired by highly sought-after historical models. Key turning points include collaborations with retailers like Gnomon for exclusive models and the introduction of an updated, more refined case design with the "Legacy" and "Nova" series in 2023 and 2026, respectively. The line consistently uses reliable Swiss automatic movements from ETA and later Sellita, maintaining its reputation for offering robustly built, high-value timepieces.
